title: AI Game Studio
author: Odd-Communication-18
selftext:
So following a post a few days ago I've created a discord with the intent of gathering some AI Devs together and working on a single project (or multiple if we get a lot of people)

If people are interested and join we'll have discussions in a few days on what we want to do and how we're going to do it but essentially it should work something like this:

\- We collectively decide on a game to make

\- People pick roles they want to begin with (I'm happy with changing roles when you want)

\- project lead begins building the foundations, git, build and merger details and begins adding stuff to the to-do list

\- people pick something to work on, build it, run basic tests then hands to project lead for merging

I'm thinking we should set up something like Jira where we can list development items and bugs for Devs to pick up that shows what's already been taken or done so people aren't doubling up

An important note, until we publish a game that actually makes money this will have to be unpaid but that's pretty much how every studio starts.

If you're interested, leave a comment and I'll send an invite to the discord, let's see if we can build something awesome!

\[For the mod team, I think this post follows the rules but feel free to delete if it's not\]
